title: Decoherence in Waveguide Quantum Electrodynamics using Matrix Product States
summary: We present a matrix product state (MPS) method for including decoherence processes in calculations involving waveguide quantum electrodynamics (waveguide QED) using density matrices. The approach is based on collision quantum optics, where the many-body state of the waveguide is represented using discrete time bins, which are then efficiently encoded using an MPS chain.
